# Image Fixture Manifest

These fixtures are shared by upload, thumbnail, avatar, SVG, optimizer, and image-policy specs. Prefer reusing or adding tiny deterministic fixtures over running expensive image optimization in tests.

Some specs create temporary fixtures from inline recipes when storing binary files would add little value. `spec/lib/upload_creator_spec.rb` uses a 3x2 JPEG generated by `magick -size 3x2 xc:white` and injects EXIF orientation headers in pure Ruby to cover orientation 1-8 without adding eight files.

## Valid Small Fixtures

| Fixture | Intent | Source or recipe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resized.png` | 5x5 PNG used for tiny resize/crop/downsize characterization | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `cropped.png` | 5x1 PNG with stable mixed colors for dominant-color and upload metadata checks | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `png_as.bin` | PNG bytes with a wrong extension for type detection | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `smallest.png` | 1x1 PNG for favicon/thumbnail edge cases | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `smallest.ico` | ICO converted to the selected PNG frame | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `logo.png`, `logo.jpg` | Small representative raster fixtures for resize, quality, and store flows | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |
| `animated.gif`, `animated.webp` | Animated originals that should remain animated and avoid JPEG/downsize paths | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |
| `should_be_jpeg.png` | PNG large enough to satisfy PNG-to-JPEG conversion thresholds | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `large_and_unoptimized.png`, `pngquant.png` | Optimizer and conversion-threshold fixtures | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |
| `should_be_jpeg.heic` | HEIC/HEIF conversion coverage | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `huge.jpg`, `2000x2000.png` | Pixel-limit and dimension-reconstruction coverage | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |

## SVG Fixtures

| Fixture | Intent | Source or recipe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image.svg` | Basic sanitized SVG upload and optimized-copy behavior | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `tiny.svg` | Non-pixel unit dimensions that resolve to 115x86 | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `massive.svg` | Oversized SVG dimensions for thumbnail-bound checks | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `zero_sized.svg` | Edge-case SVG dimension handling | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `custom-theme-icon-sprite.svg`, `custom-theme-component-icon-sprite.svg`, `bad-xml-icon-sprite.svg` | Theme/custom emoji SVG upload and parser coverage | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |
| `hostile_external.svg` | Event attributes and external `href`/`xlink:href` sanitization | Deterministic text fixture authored for ImageMagick-port characterization |
| `hostile_entity.svg` | XML subset and entity-reference sanitization | Deterministic text fixture authored for ImageMagick-port characterization |

## Hostile Or Invalid Fixtures

| Fixture | Intent | Source or recipe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `svg.png` | SVG content masked as PNG to ensure raster paths fail closed | Tracked Discourse test fixture |
| `fake.jpg`, `fake.not_image`, `not_an_image`, `image_no_extension` | Invalid or ambiguous upload inputs | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |
| `tiff_as.bin`, `webp_as.bin` | Type-detection edge cases and unsupported/alternate formats | Tracked Discourse test fixtures |

## Fixture Gaps

Future characterization should add tiny deterministic fixtures for EXIF orientations 1-8 with asymmetric corner markers, malformed/private ICC profiles, CMYK/grayscale/sRGB profile variants, alpha-halo flattening, hostile SVG masks/viewBox-only units, tiny animated AVIF where decoder support is available, and conversion-failure cleanup inputs.
